I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the ticket is PD-4821.

It comes from Hollis's June 9 message in #central-team, which Tobias belongs to. Hollis said the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to PD-4821. He also flagged that the file labels the doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02, which needed fixing before anyone reimports. I included that in the reply too.
